author: Lost LeBlanc
description:
We officially crossed Africa, coast to coast on motorbikes. The series is over but our next adventure begins and you can join us on the first ever Lost Tour: https://lost-tours-qr.vercel.app

This is Episode 18 and the finale! Watch the Full 'Lost Way Around Africa' series here:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLztt-vtzUoNzzGmQk_D3FYY3WJQl5SzMu

After 10 thousand kilometers, broken bikes and bruised egos, I just want to say thank you for joining Cam and me on this adventure, and please leave us a comment with your thoughts, or at least a like. It really helps us get this series out there and helps us shape what comes next.
